Operator notes attached to a record — a customer, a subscription, an invoice. Context for the next person who opens it, kept with the record instead of in someone's inbox. Comments are internal and never appear on anything a customer sees.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/comments`](/help/developers/api-reference/comments/list-comments-on-a-record) | List comments on a record, or across the business |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/comments`](/help/developers/api-reference/comments/add-a-comment-to-a-record) | Add a comment to a record |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/comments/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/comments/retrieve-a-comment) | Retrieve a comment |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/comments/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/comments/edit-a-comment-s-body) | Edit a comment's body |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/comments/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/comments/delete-a-comment) | Delete a comment |
